g.text: AI agents use a database and an LLM with a KV cache
Each agent reads and writes data. Each agent sends prompts to the LLM. The KV cache keeps the entries of each agent.
Solid arrow: the sender pushes data or a request.
Dashed arrow: the receiver gets data or a response.
Color: each color shows one agent. The KV cache rows with that color
are the entries of that agent. All agents share the orange rows.
